# The Ahqar Collection - Abaya Image Folder

Place your 5 Abaya product images in this folder with the following filenames:

1. `abaya-1.jpg` (or `.png` / `.webp`) - Noor Silk Abaya
2. `abaya-2.jpg` - Gulzar Blush Layered Abaya
3. `abaya-3.jpg` - Zahra Velvet Trim Abaya
4. `abaya-4.jpg` - Inayat Pearl Embellished Abaya
5. `abaya-5.jpg` - Ruhi Pleated Kaftan Abaya

The website will automatically load these files! If an image file is missing, an elegant soft pink watercolor placeholder card is displayed as a fallback.
